name: shoots
description: shoots — scriptable batch automation for photography workflows (monorepo root)
author: Stefano Pascazi <stefanopascazi@gmail.com>

scripts.test: npm run build -w @shoots/cli && bun test packages/cli/test --timeout 120000
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['core','imaging','inference','match','cli']) require('fs').rmSync(`packages/${p}/dist`, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.preversion: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run docs:migrations -- --check
scripts.postversion: git push origin main && git push origin --tags
